column1: In 2019, we conducted a total of 4,082 assessments to help us determine which suppliers
to work with and, for those we do engage, to help us continually understand and improve
those suppliers’ practices. We utilize three types of assessments:
Suppliers must submit an Amazon-approved assessment of their facilities before beginning production of Amazon-
•  44% of assessments conducted in 2019 were Pre-Production Assessments.
Suppliers must submit Amazon-approved assessments on an ongoing basis while producing Amazon products.
•  35% of assessments conducted in 2019 were Ongoing Assessments of active suppliers.
